name: Remington Keratin Protect Intelligent Hair Straightener | Model FR-2028 | Advanced Ceramic Plates & Heat Protection Sensor
description:
Style your hair with confidence using the Remington Keratin Protect Intelligent Hair Straightener, designed to deliver smooth, shiny, and healthy-looking results while helping protect your hair from excessive heat damage. Featuring Advanced Ceramic coated plates infused with keratin micro-conditioners, this intelligent straightener glides effortlessly through hair for sleek, salon-quality styling. Its innovative Heat Protection Sensor continuously monitors moisture levels and automatically adjusts the temperature to provide optimal styling performance while reducing heat-related damage. Ready to use in just 60 seconds, this professional hair straightener combines speed, convenience, and advanced hair protection technology.
The 3-meter swivel cord offers maximum flexibility during styling, while the included heat-resistant pouch/mat ensures safe storage after use.

Intelligent Keratin Protect Technology
Advanced Ceramic coated styling plates
Keratin-infused micro-conditioners
Heat Protection Sensor for safer styling
Even heat distribution for consistent results
Fast heat-up in just 60 seconds
Smooth gliding plates reduce frizz
On/Off indicator light

Suitable for all hair types

How to Use
Plug in the straightener and switch it on
Allow approximately 60 seconds to heat up
Brush and section dry hair
Glide the plates smoothly from root to tip
Repeat until desired styling results are achieved
Switch off and allow to cool before storage

Keratin Conditioning Technology
Heat-Resistant Exterior Housing

Keep away from water and moisture
Do not touch heated plates during operation
Unplug after use
Allow to cool completely before storing
Keep out of reach of children
